title: Frequently asked questions
subtitle: Answers to questions we hear most often from clients

items.question: What kind of companies do you work with?
items.answer: We mainly work with Polish small and medium-sized businesses that want to use IT and automation as growth leverage, not just a cost line. Our clients range from manufacturing and service companies to technical teams inside larger organizations.

items.question: How much does automation or AI implementation cost?
items.answer: We price every project individually after a free consultation, because the scope varies a lot between clients. Simple single-process automations start at a few thousand PLN; complex AI implementations and system integrations run into tens of thousands. After our call you get a concrete quote and a timeline.

items.question: What does the engagement process look like?
items.answer: We start with a free 30-minute consultation to understand your problem and business goals. Next, we prepare a solution proposal and quote. Once approved, we deliver the project in short iterations, shipping working increments every 1–2 weeks so you stay fully in control.

items.question: Why open source and Red Hat?
items.answer: Open source gives you vendor independence, full control over your data, and no sudden licensing hikes. Red Hat adds enterprise-grade commercial support (OpenShift, RHEL, Ansible) required by banks, insurance firms and the public sector. It's open source flexibility combined with the reliability of a stable vendor.

items.question: What AI technologies do you use?
items.answer: We pick tools to fit the problem, not the other way around. We work with commercial models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude) and open source models (Llama, Mistral) hosted locally when GDPR or confidentiality requires it. We implement AI assistants, document classification, data analysis and AI-enhanced workflow automations.

items.question: Do you work remotely or on-site?
items.answer: We work in a hybrid model — most work (analysis, development, rollout) happens remotely, which speeds up projects and lowers cost. Kickoff workshops, key reviews and team training can be done on-site at your office anywhere in Poland.

items.question: Is my company's data safe?
items.answer: Yes. We operate in line with GDPR, sign Data Processing Agreements (DPA) and NDAs. For sensitive projects we use locally hosted AI models that don't send data outside your infrastructure. Code, documentation and project assets live in your repositories or dedicated, encrypted spaces.

items.question: How quickly can we start?
items.answer: You can book the first consultation straight away through our online calendar. From contract signing to project kickoff usually takes 1–2 weeks — in urgent cases we can start sooner.
